> 第9章 名声相逼（第1页）
坐拥江山，最大的掌权者，更想要保持年轻力壮，长命百岁。
皇帝当太子当了将近四十年，太上皇一直不死，好不容易生病让他登了基，到如今也不过才两年。
新皇二年，就听到晋王说他老得脸上有皱纹了，真是杀人诛心。
所以说他就不喜欢这个小皇弟，越长大越讨厌。
“朕比阿阅年长了二十岁，自然是比你成熟了些。”皇帝为自己挽尊。
他的后妃都说他很显年轻的，看着像三十出头，而且他在龙床上还很威风。哼，万万不能一见面就被晋王打击了，他要撑住。
“嗯，皇兄奔五了。”晋王很是自然地接了一句。
“阿阅，快进来，跟朕好好聊聊，这些年你都去了哪里，有什么好玩的事儿，朕日理万机，连这皇宫都难走出一步，想想还挺羡慕你的，自由洒脱。”皇帝招呼他进御书房。
在他迈步过门槛的时候，晋王语气平淡地说了一句，“皇兄，闲话就暂时不说了，先给我赐个婚吧。”
皇帝脚下一个踉跄，差点被门槛给绊倒。
内侍吓了一跳，赶紧来扶。“皇上！”
皇帝站稳了，晋王背着一手气定神闲走了进来，环视了御书房一眼。
“阿阅，你刚才说什么？朕好像听错了？你说要赐婚？”
“你之前写信给父皇，不是说在外面四处游山玩水，连个母蚊子都不叮你？”
这话是太上皇说的。太上皇一直都担心小儿子这辈子不成亲，要孤寡终老。
晋王脑子里浮现陆昭菱的俏脸，唇角一勾，“是啊，谁知道京城里有小狐狸。”
他是个信守承诺的人，答应了合作就不会反悔。
“小狐狸？”皇帝也不傻，听着这话就知道指的是那个要赐婚的姑娘，“是哪家的姑娘啊？”
晋王正要说话，外面宫人一声传呼，“太后娘娘到！”
“母后来了？”皇帝站了起来，“想必是听说你回来，激动欢喜了。”
太后带着沈湘珺进来，目光一下子就落到晋王身上。
上回见到晋王，他还是个十几岁少年。
现在眼前的晋王已经是个身材颀长，沉稳矜贵的成年男子，他站在皇帝身边，比皇帝足足高出半个头，一身深紫锦袍衬得他贵气逼人，竟然把身穿龙袍的皇帝给衬得有点油腻猥琐。
“今早就听到喜雀喳喳叫，果真是有喜事，晋王回来了！”太后看着晋王，用丝绢轻压了压眼角，声音都带着点儿哽咽，“前些日子，我还梦见你了，惊醒之后担心得吃不好，现在看见你好好的，我就放心了。”
太后还是跟以前一样，喜欢找尽一切机会诅咒他，但偏偏神情表现无懈可击，真的对他的回来很激动很高兴。
“太后放心，本王会好好的，绝不让你担心。”晋王说。
沈湘珺进来行了礼之后就站在一旁，看着晋王，她的眼眶也微微红了。
他的眉眼他的脸型，无一不是长在她最钟爱的点上。

> Chapter 9 Competing by reputation (page 1)
Sitting on the throne, the most powerful person wants to stay young and strong and live a long life.
The emperor has been the crown prince for nearly forty years, and the emperor has never died. He finally became ill and ascended the throne. It has only been two years now.
In the second year of the new emperor's reign, I heard the King of Jin say that he was so old that he had wrinkles on his face, which was really heartbreaking.
So he didn't like this little emperor brother, and the older he got, the more disgusted he became.
"I am twenty years older than Ayue, so naturally I am more mature than you." The emperor defended himself.
His concubines all said that he looked very young, looking like he was in his early thirties, and he was very majestic on the dragon bed. Humph, he must not be attacked by King Jin as soon as they meet. He must hold on.
"Well, the emperor's brother is running for the fifth time." King Jin answered naturally.
"Ayue, come in quickly and have a good chat with me. Where have you been over the years and what interesting things have you done? I have so many things to do every day that I can't even take a step out of this palace. Thinking about it, I envy you. You are free and easy." The emperor greeted him into the royal study.
When he stepped across the threshold, King Jin said calmly, "Brother, let's put aside the gossip for the time being and grant me a marriage first."
The emperor stumbled and almost tripped over the threshold.
The chamberlain was startled and rushed to help him. "Your Majesty!"
The emperor stood firm, and Prince Jin walked in leisurely with a hand on his back and looked around the imperial study.
"Ayue, what did you just say? I think I heard you wrong? You said you wanted to grant a marriage?"
"When you wrote to my father before, didn't you say that you were traveling around and not even a female mosquito would bite you?"
This was said by the Supreme Emperor. The Supreme Emperor has always been worried that his youngest son will never get married and will end up alone.
Lu Zhaoling's pretty face appeared in King Jin's mind, and the corner of his lips curled up, "Yeah, who knew there was a little fox in the capital."
He is a man of his word and will never go back on his word if he agrees to cooperate.
"Little fox?" The emperor was not stupid. After hearing these words, he knew that he was referring to the girl who was going to be married. "Which girl is she from?"
Just as King Jin was about to speak, someone from the palace called out, "The Queen Mother is here!"
"Is your mother here?" The emperor stood up, "I must be excited and happy to hear that you are back."
The Queen Mother came in with Shen Xiangjun, and her eyes immediately fell on King Jin.
The last time I saw King Jin, he was still a teenager.
The King of Jin in front of him now is a slender, calm and dignified adult man. He is standing next to the emperor, half a head taller than the emperor. His dark purple brocade robe makes him look very noble, and actually makes the emperor who is wearing the dragon robe look a little greasy and wretched.
"I heard the chirping of the happy birds this morning. It's really a happy event. Prince Jin is back!" The Queen Mother looked at Prince Jin and pressed the corners of her eyes lightly with silk. Her voice was a little choked. "I dreamed of you a few days ago. After I woke up, I was so worried that I couldn't eat well. Now that I see you are well, I feel relieved."
The Queen Mother was still the same as before, she liked to find every opportunity to curse him, but her expression was impeccable and she was really excited and happy about his return.
"Don't worry, Queen Mother, I will be fine and will never let you worry." King Jin said.
After Shen Xiangjun came in and bowed, she stood aside and looked at King Jin, her eyes turning slightly red.
His eyebrows, eyes, and face shape were all her favorite features.
